name: Camp Assistant (CA), YMCA Camp Loma Mar
city: Loma Mar, CA (YMCA Camp Loma Mar, 9900 Pescadero Creek Road)
what_you_do: You spend two weeks at an overnight camp getting ready to work there. You train in child development, child abuse prevention, and planning activities for kids, and you shadow camp staff.
who_can_apply: Rising seniors (12th grade in fall 2027). Full acceptance depends on references and an interview. No city or residency rule is stated.
pay_detail: The full CA program cost is not stated. The application asks for a $25 refundable deposit. Campership (financial aid) applications are part of camp registration.
duration: Two weeks: June 20 to 25 and June 27 to July 2, 2027.
deadline_text: The 2027 CA application opens January 1, 2027. Interviews are scheduled in spring 2027. The session runs June 20 to July 2, 2027. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Starting January 1, 2027, send in the CA form on the camp's sign up site. Pay a $25 deposit, which you can get back. You need both the form and an interview.
notes: Run by YMCA of the East Bay. One line of the 2027 CA listing still says '12th grade in Fall of 2026' while its title says fall 2027; confirm with the camp. In 2026 the camp sold round-trip buses from the Oakland YMCA and the EM Downer YMCA ($150), and LITs and CAs went home Friday and Saturday nights between weeks; 2027 bus details are not posted. Teens entering 10th or 11th grade can apply to Leaders in Training (LIT) instead. Contact: clmteam@ymcaeastbay.org.
